items.text: Alice was sitting. <break time="0.8s" /> By her sister. <break time="0.8s" /> On a river bank. <break time="0.8s" /> And she was very bored. <break time="0.8s" /> Once or twice. <break time="0.8s" /> She looked into the book. <break time="0.8s" /> That her sister was reading. <break time="0.8s" /> But it had no pictures. <break time="0.8s" /> Or conversations in it. <break time="0.8s" /> And what is the use of a book. <break time="0.8s" /> Thought Alice. <break time="0.8s" /> Without pictures or conversations. <break time="0.8s" /> The hot day made her. <break time="0.8s" /> Feel sleepy and a little stupid. <break time="0.8s" /> She was wondering. <break time="0.8s" /> Whether she should get up. <break time="0.8s" /> And make a daisy chain. <break time="0.8s" /> Suddenly a White Rabbit. <break time="0.8s" /> With pink eyes. <break time="0.8s" /> Ran close by her. <break time="0.8s" /> The Rabbit said to itself. <break time="0.8s" /> Oh dear, Oh dear. <break time="0.8s" /> I shall be late. <break time="0.8s" /> But then the Rabbit took a watch. <break time="0.8s" /> Out of its waistcoat pocket. <break time="0.8s" /> And hurried on. <break time="0.8s" /> Alice jumped up. <break time="0.8s" /> Because she had never seen. <break time="0.8s" /> A rabbit with a pocket or a watch. <break time="0.8s" /> She ran after it. <break time="0.8s" /> And saw it pop down. <break time="0.8s" /> A large rabbit hole under the hedge. <break time="0.8s" /> Alice went down after it. <break time="0.8s" /> Without thinking. <break time="0.8s" /> How she would get out.

Alice was sitting by her sister on a river bank, and she was very bored. <break time="0.8s" /> Once or twice she looked into the book that her sister was reading. <break time="0.8s" /> But it had no pictures or conversations in it. <break time="0.8s" /> And what is the use of a book, thought Alice, without pictures or conversations. <break time="0.8s" /> The hot day made her feel sleepy and a little stupid. <break time="0.8s" /> She was wondering whether she should get up and make a daisy chain. <break time="0.8s" /> Suddenly a White Rabbit with pink eyes ran close by her. <break time="0.8s" /> The Rabbit said to itself, Oh dear, Oh dear, I shall be late. <break time="0.8s" /> But then the Rabbit took a watch out of its waistcoat pocket and hurried on. <break time="0.8s" /> Alice jumped up, because she had never seen a rabbit with a pocket or a watch. <break time="0.8s" /> She ran after it and saw it pop down a large rabbit hole under the hedge. <break time="0.8s" /> Alice went down after it without thinking how she would get out.

앨리스는 앉아 있었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 언니 옆에. <break time="0.8s" /> 강둑 위에. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 그녀는 몹시 심심했다. <break time="0.8s" /> 한두 번. <break time="0.8s" /> 그녀는 그 책을 들여다보았다. <break time="0.8s" /> 언니가 읽고 있던. <break time="0.8s" /> 하지만 그 책에는 그림이 없었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 대화도 없었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 책이 무슨 쓸모가 있담. <break time="0.8s" /> 앨리스는 생각했다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그림도 대화도 없는데. <break time="0.8s" /> 더운 날씨 때문에 그녀는. <break time="0.8s" /> 졸리고 머리가 좀 멍했다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그녀는 생각하고 있었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 일어나야 할지 말지. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 데이지 꽃목걸이를 만들지. <break time="0.8s" /> 갑자기 흰 토끼 한 마리가. <break time="0.8s" /> 분홍색 눈을 한. <break time="0.8s" /> 그녀 바로 옆을 달려갔다. <break time="0.8s" /> 토끼는 혼잣말을 했다. <break time="0.8s" /> 이런, 이런. <break time="0.8s" /> 늦겠어. <break time="0.8s" /> 그런데 그때 토끼가 시계를 꺼냈다. <break time="0.8s" /> 조끼 주머니에서. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 서둘러 갔다. <break time="0.8s" /> 앨리스는 벌떡 일어났다. <break time="0.8s" /> 한 번도 본 적이 없었기 때문이다. <break time="0.8s" /> 주머니나 시계를 가진 토끼를. <break time="0.8s" /> 그녀는 토끼를 쫓아 달려갔다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 토끼가 쏙 들어가는 것을 보았다. <break time="0.8s" /> 산울타리 밑의 커다란 토끼 굴로. <break time="0.8s" /> 앨리스는 토끼를 따라 내려갔다. <break time="0.8s" /> 생각도 하지 않고. <break time="0.8s" /> 어떻게 나올지.

The rabbit hole went straight on like a tunnel. <break time="0.8s" /> For some way. <break time="0.8s" /> Then it dipped suddenly. <break time="0.8s" /> And Alice found herself. <break time="0.8s" /> Falling down a very deep well. <break time="0.8s" /> Either the well was very deep. <break time="0.8s" /> Or she fell very slowly. <break time="0.8s" /> She had plenty of time. <break time="0.8s" /> To look around. <break time="0.8s" /> And to wonder. <break time="0.8s" /> What would happen next. <break time="0.8s" /> The sides of the well. <break time="0.8s" /> Were filled with cupboards and bookshelves. <break time="0.8s" /> As she passed. <break time="0.8s" /> She took down a jar. <break time="0.8s" /> From one of the shelves. <break time="0.8s" /> It had a label. <break time="0.8s" /> That said ORANGE MARMALADE. <break time="0.8s" /> But it was empty. <break time="0.8s" /> She did not want to drop it. <break time="0.8s" /> Because it might hit. <break time="0.8s" /> Someone below. <break time="0.8s" /> So she put it. <break time="0.8s" /> Into a cupboard. <break time="0.8s" /> As she fell past it. <break time="0.8s" /> After a fall like this. <break time="0.8s" /> Falling downstairs will be nothing. <break time="0.8s" /> Thought Alice. <break time="0.8s" /> She wondered. <break time="0.8s" /> If she was getting near the center of the earth. <break time="0.8s" /> She also said grand words. <break time="0.8s" /> Like Latitude and Longitude. <break time="0.8s" /> Which she did not understand at all.

토끼 굴은 곧게 이어졌다 터널처럼. <break time="0.8s" /> 한동안. <break time="0.8s" /> 그러다 굴이 갑자기 아래로 꺼졌다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 정신을 차려 보니 앨리스는. <break time="0.8s" /> 아주 깊은 우물 아래로 떨어지고 있었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 우물이 아주 깊었거나. <break time="0.8s" /> 아니면 그녀가 아주 천천히 떨어졌다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그녀에게는 시간이 충분했다. <break time="0.8s" /> 주위를 둘러볼. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 생각해 볼. <break time="0.8s" /> 다음에 무슨 일이 일어날지. <break time="0.8s" /> 우물의 벽은. <break time="0.8s" /> 가득 차 있었다 찬장과 책장으로. <break time="0.8s" /> 지나가면서. <break time="0.8s" /> 그녀는 병 하나를 꺼냈다. <break time="0.8s" /> 선반들 중 하나에서. <break time="0.8s" /> 병에는 상표가 붙어 있었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 오렌지 마멀레이드라고 쓰인. <break time="0.8s" /> 하지만 병은 비어 있었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그녀는 병을 떨어뜨리고 싶지 않았다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그것이 맞힐지도 몰랐기 때문이다. <break time="0.8s" /> 아래에 있는 누군가를. <break time="0.8s" /> 그래서 그녀는 병을 넣었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 찬장 안에. <break time="0.8s" /> 그 옆을 떨어져 지나가면서. <break time="0.8s" /> 이렇게 떨어지고 나면. <break time="0.8s" /> 계단에서 구르는 건 아무것도 아니겠어. <break time="0.8s" /> 앨리스는 생각했다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그녀는 궁금했다. <break time="0.8s" /> 자기가 가까워지고 있는지 지구 한가운데에. <break time="0.8s" /> 그녀는 거창한 말도 해 보았다. <break time="0.8s" /> 위도와 경도 같은 말이었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그런데 그 말들을 그녀는 전혀 이해하지 못했다.

Perhaps I will fall. <break time="0.8s" /> Right through the earth. <break time="0.8s" /> She said to herself. <break time="0.8s" /> Then I will meet the people. <break time="0.8s" /> Who walk with their heads downward. <break time="0.8s" /> She would ask them. <break time="0.8s" /> Please, Madam. <break time="0.8s" /> Is this New Zealand or Australia. <break time="0.8s" /> She even tried to curtsey. <break time="0.8s" /> While she was falling through the air. <break time="0.8s" /> There was nothing else to do so Alice soon began talking again. <break time="0.8s" /> Dinah will miss me. <break time="0.8s" /> Very much tonight. <break time="0.8s" /> Said Alice. <break time="0.8s" /> Dinah was the cat. <break time="0.8s" /> That Alice had left at home. <break time="0.8s" /> I hope. <break time="0.8s" /> They will remember her saucer of milk. <break time="0.8s" /> At teatime. <break time="0.8s" /> There are no mice in the air. <break time="0.8s" /> But a bat is very much like a mouse. <break time="0.8s" /> But do cats eat bats. <break time="0.8s" /> She wondered sleepily. <break time="0.8s" /> She began to dream. <break time="0.8s" /> That she was walking. <break time="0.8s" /> Hand in hand with Dinah. <break time="0.8s" /> Then, thump, thump. <break time="0.8s" /> Alice landed. <break time="0.8s" /> On a heap of sticks and dry leaves.

Perhaps I will fall right through the earth, she said to herself. <break time="0.8s" /> Then I will meet the people who walk with their heads downward. <break time="0.8s" /> She would ask them, Please, Madam, is this New Zealand or Australia. <break time="0.8s" /> She even tried to curtsey while she was falling through the air. <break time="0.8s" /> There was nothing else to do, so Alice soon began talking again. <break time="0.8s" /> Dinah will miss me very much tonight, said Alice. <break time="0.8s" /> Dinah was the cat that Alice had left at home. <break time="0.8s" /> I hope they will remember her saucer of milk at teatime. <break time="0.8s" /> There are no mice in the air, but a bat is very much like a mouse. <break time="0.8s" /> But do cats eat bats, she wondered sleepily. <break time="0.8s" /> She began to dream that she was walking hand in hand with Dinah. <break time="0.8s" /> Then, thump, thump, Alice landed on a heap of sticks and dry leaves.

어쩌면 나는 떨어질지도 몰라. <break time="0.8s" /> 지구를 똑바로 뚫고. <break time="0.8s" /> 그녀는 혼잣말을 했다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그러면 나는 그 사람들을 만나겠지. <break time="0.8s" /> 머리를 아래로 하고 걷는. <break time="0.8s" /> 그녀는 그들에게 물어볼 생각이었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 실례지만, 부인. <break time="0.8s" /> 여기가 뉴질랜드인가요, 오스트레일리아인가요. <break time="0.8s" /> 그녀는 무릎을 굽혀 인사하려고까지 했다. <break time="0.8s" /> 공중으로 떨어지는 동안. <break time="0.8s" /> 달리 할 일이 없었다 그래서 앨리스는 곧 다시 말하기 시작했다. <break time="0.8s" /> 다이나가 나를 보고 싶어 할 거야. <break time="0.8s" /> 오늘 밤 무척. <break time="0.8s" /> 앨리스가 말했다. <break time="0.8s" /> 다이나는 고양이였다. <break time="0.8s" /> 앨리스가 집에 두고 온. <break time="0.8s" /> 나는 바라. <break time="0.8s" /> 사람들이 다이나의 우유 접시를 기억하기를. <break time="0.8s" /> 차 마실 시간에. <break time="0.8s" /> 공중에는 쥐가 없어. <break time="0.8s" /> 하지만 박쥐는 쥐랑 아주 비슷해. <break time="0.8s" /> 그런데 고양이가 박쥐를 먹나. <break time="0.8s" /> 그녀는 졸린 듯이 궁금해했다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그녀는 꿈을 꾸기 시작했다. <break time="0.8s" /> 자기가 걷고 있는 꿈이었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 다이나와 손을 잡고. <break time="0.8s" /> 그러다 쿵, 쿵. <break time="0.8s" /> 앨리스는 떨어졌다. <break time="0.8s" /> 나뭇가지와 마른 잎 더미 위에.

Alice was not hurt at all. <break time="0.8s" /> And far ahead she saw. <break time="0.8s" /> The White Rabbit hurrying away. <break time="0.8s" /> Oh my ears and whiskers. <break time="0.8s" /> How late it is getting. <break time="0.8s" /> It cried. <break time="0.8s" /> Alice ran after it. <break time="0.8s" /> But when she turned the corner. <break time="0.8s" /> The Rabbit was gone. <break time="0.8s" /> She was in a long, low hall. <break time="0.8s" /> Which was lit. <break time="0.8s" /> By a row of lamps. <break time="0.8s" /> There were doors. <break time="0.8s" /> All around the hall. <break time="0.8s" /> But they were all locked. <break time="0.8s" /> Then she found. <break time="0.8s" /> A little three legged table. <break time="0.8s" /> That was made of solid glass. <break time="0.8s" /> There was a tiny golden key on it. <break time="0.8s" /> But it was too small. <break time="0.8s" /> For the doors. <break time="0.8s" /> Behind a low curtain. <break time="0.8s" /> She found a little door. <break time="0.8s" /> About fifteen inches high. <break time="0.8s" /> She tried the golden key. <break time="0.8s" /> In the lock. <break time="0.8s" /> And to her great delight. <break time="0.8s" /> It fitted. <break time="0.8s" /> The door opened. <break time="0.8s" /> Into a small passage. <break time="0.8s" /> Which led to the loveliest garden. <break time="0.8s" /> Alice wanted to go out. <break time="0.8s" /> But she could not even get her head. <break time="0.8s" /> Through the doorway. <break time="0.8s" /> Oh, how I wish. <break time="0.8s" /> I could shut up like a telescope. <break time="0.8s" /> She said.

Alice was not hurt at all, and far ahead she saw the White Rabbit hurrying away. <break time="0.8s" /> Oh my ears and whiskers, how late it is getting, it cried. <break time="0.8s" /> Alice ran after it, but when she turned the corner, the Rabbit was gone. <break time="0.8s" /> She was in a long, low hall, which was lit by a row of lamps. <break time="0.8s" /> There were doors all around the hall, but they were all locked. <break time="0.8s" /> Then she found a little three legged table that was made of solid glass. <break time="0.8s" /> There was a tiny golden key on it, but it was too small for the doors. <break time="0.8s" /> Behind a low curtain, she found a little door about fifteen inches high. <break time="0.8s" /> She tried the golden key in the lock, and to her great delight, it fitted. <break time="0.8s" /> The door opened into a small passage, which led to the loveliest garden. <break time="0.8s" /> Alice wanted to go out, but she could not even get her head through the doorway. <break time="0.8s" /> Oh, how I wish I could shut up like a telescope, she said.
